- **llms.txt and LLM-readable documentation** — llms.txt is a documentation index file that links to Markdown pages for AI tools to fetch directly. — https://resend.com/docs/introduction · evidence: hub estate · origin: llm (grounded 0.60)

- **llms.txt** — A markdown file — `/llms.txt` at a site root or at any subpath — that gives a language model a curated, priority-ordered map of a site's LLM-friendly content: an H1, a blockquote summary, optional prose, then H2 sections of `- [name](url): description` links. · aka: /llms.txt, /llmstxt · not: /docs/llms.txt · differs: not rewrite only `/docs/llms.txt` to a root-hosted `/llms.txt`. — https://llmstxt.org/

- **/docs/llms.txt** — A machine-readable file containing documentation for an email API, hosted at /docs/llms.txt. · not: llms.txt · differs: not rewrite only `/docs/llms.txt` to a root-hosted `/llms.txt`. — https://resend.com/docs/introduction · evidence: hub estate · origin: llm (grounded 0.56, verify before citing)

- **rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"** — A link relation indicating a markdown version of a resource, used in HTTP headers or HTML links. · not: rel="describedby" · differs: Refers to an llms.txt file, not a markdown twin of the resource — https://joost.blog/markdown-alternate/ · origin: llm (grounded 0.45, verify before citing)
- **Accept: text/markdown** — Accept: text/markdown is a content negotiation header to serve Markdown content when requested. · not: Content negotiation, Full-page caches · differs: Accept: text/markdown is a specific header, not a general content negotiation method. — https://vercel.com/blog/making-agent-friendly-pages-with-content-negotiation · origin: llm (grounded 0.67)
- **Content-Type: text/markdown** — Content-Type: text/markdown is a header indicating Markdown content is served, used by Cloudflare's Markdown for Agents feature. · not: Content-Type: audio/aac · differs: Used for AAC files, not Markdown content. — https://vercel.com/blog/making-agent-friendly-pages-with-content-negotiation · origin: llm (grounded 0.55, verify before citing)
- **x-markdown-tokens** — x-markdown-tokens is a header indicating the estimated token count of a Markdown document generated from HTML conversion. · not: llms-small.txt, x-original-tokens, llms.txt · differs: rather than one file: an index (≤10 KB), a small variant (Starlight `llms-small.txt`; Nuxt's ~5K-token file), and the fu — https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/markdown-for-agents/ · evidence: hub estate · origin: llm (grounded 0.82)
- **x-original-tokens** — x-original-tokens is the estimated token count of the original HTML document before conversion to Markdown. · not: x-markdown-tokens · differs: x-original-tokens refers to the original HTML tokens, while x-markdown-tokens refers to the converted Markdown tokens. — https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/markdown-for-agents/ · evidence: hub estate · origin: llm (grounded 0.60)
- **Vary: Accept** — Vary: Accept indicates the response varies based on the Accept header, affecting cache behavior. · not: Vary: Accept-Encoding · differs: Only accepted header for compression options, not for content type variations. — https://developers.cloudflare.com/cache/advanced-configuration/vary-for-images/ · evidence: hub estate · origin: llm (grounded 0.50, verify before citing)
- **llms-small.txt** — llms-small.txt is a small variant of a tokenized text file used to enforce size budgets on the producer-side. · not: /_llms/, x-markdown-tokens, llms.txt, x-max-tokens · differs: not consumer-side truncation: Mintlify's `/_llms/` recursion, Starlight's `llms-small.txt`, Nuxt's two sizes, Firecrawl' — https://www.mintlify.com/docs/ai/llmstxt · evidence: hub estate · origin: llm (grounded 0.64)

- **create-llmstxt-py** — create-llmstxt-py is a Firecrawl tool that scrapes URLs to markdown, generates titles and descriptions, and outputs flat llms.txt files. · not: platform generators · differs: it uses a crawl map instead of walking docs nav trees — https://github.com/firecrawl/create-llmstxt-py · origin: llm (grounded 0.54, verify before citing)
